promptText: For an upper-upscale hotel project in Mexico, which brands are commonly shortlisted by owners and developers?
rawResponse:
For an **upper‑upscale hotel project in Mexico**, owners and developers frequently shortlist a range of both global and regional brands—particularly those with strong market recognition, operational expertise, and alignment with local luxury and lifestyle trends. Based on current insights (circa mid‑2026), here are the most commonly selected brands in this category:

Hyatt (Inclusive and Upper‑Upscale Portfolio)
- Through its **Inclusive Collection**—including **Secrets**, **Dreams**, **Zoëtry**, and **Breathless**—Hyatt is a key partner in the development of luxury all‑inclusive resorts across Mexico and the Caribbean. This collection benefits from Hyatt’s international distribution and loyalty platform and remains a leading choice for upper‑upscale projects. ([elpais.com](https://elpais.com/economia/2025-10-15/mexico-y-el-caribe-polos-de-inversion-para-el-turismo-de-lujo.html?utm_source=openai))
- In urban and lifestyle-oriented developments, brands like **Andaz** also feature prominently; for example, *Andaz Mexico City Condesa* exemplifies Hyatt’s upper‑upscale/luxury lifestyle offering. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands?utm_source=openai))

Marriott / Ritz‑Carlton / St. Regis / Autograph / W / Rosewood / Waldorf Astoria
- According to El Financiero (June 2026), brands such as **The Ritz‑Carlton**, **Four Seasons**, **St. Regis**, **Autograph Collection**, **Rosewood**, **Waldorf Astoria**, and **W Hotels** are among the most valued by investors and developers for upper‑level luxury projects in Mexico. These brands are frequently shortlisted when developers prioritize brand equity, architectural design expression, and integration of residences. ([elfinanciero.com.mx](https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/opinion/claudia-olguin/2026/06/25/lujo-branded-expansion-y-desafios/?utm_source=openai))
- **Rosewood** is actively expanding in Mexico, with Rosewood Mexico City scheduled to open in 2027 (developed by Grupo Sordo Madaleno), reinforcing its appeal in high‑end urban developments. ([rosewoodhotels.com](https://www.rosewoodhotels.com/en/media/press/2021/rosewood-mexico-city-to-open-in-2026?utm_source=openai))

InterContinental / Luxury Flagship
- **InterContinental Hotels & Resorts** continues to enhance its presence through developments like **InterContinental Presidente Mexico City Miyana**, slated to open in late 2026. This flagship offering is a natural choice for upper‑upscale/luxury urban mixed‑use projects. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2026/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-and-grupo-presidente-advance-development-of-the-new-intercontinental?utm_source=openai))

Accor Luxury & Upper‑Upscale Brands
- Accor's luxury and upper‑upscale portfolio—featuring **Raffles**, **Orient Express**, **Fairmont**, **Sofitel**, **Emblems Collection**, and **MGallery**—is highly regarded in Mexico. Recent or upcoming projects include **Fairmont La Paz Puerta Cortés Resort & Residences** and **Mayaliah Tulum (MGallery Hotel Collection)**. ([theparagonhotel.com](https://www.theparagonhotel.com/press/accor-expands-luxury-portfolio-in-mexico?utm_source=openai))

Independent / Experiential Luxury Brands
- Developers are increasingly attracted to independent and experiential luxury operators such as **Aman**, **Rosewood**, **Auberge**, **Raffles**, and **Montage**. These brands are highly selective, focusing on prime locations and distinctive hospitality concepts, often aligned with branded residences. ([practiceguides.chambers.com](https://practiceguides.chambers.com/practice-guides/hotel-management-transactions-2026/mexico/trends-and-developments?utm_source=openai))

Other Noteworthy Mentions
- **Hard Rock Hotel** (upper‑upscale) and **BelAir Unique (by Wyndham)** – these lifestyle urban brands have presence in Guadalajara and Mexico City respectively, and are frequently chosen for modern, design‑driven developments. ([thycollection.com](https://thycollection.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **Grand Velas** and **JW Marriott** also appear in technical specifications for luxury hotel projects in top destinations like Los Cabos, Cancún, and Mexico City. These brands are often adopted in collaborations with firms like Artexa, which specializes in high‑end hospitality technical design. ([artexa.com](https://artexa.com/es/proyectos?utm_source=openai))

Summary Table (Upper‑Upscale / Luxury, Frequently Shortlisted in Mexico)

Brand Group — Notable Examples
Hyatt Inclusive Collection — Secrets, Dreams, Zoëtry, Breathless (resorts)
Hyatt Andaz — Andaz Mexico City Condesa (urban lifestyle)
Marriott Group — Ritz‑Carlton, Autograph Collection, St. Regis, W, Waldorf Astoria, Four Seasons (urban + resort)
InterContinental — InterContinental Presidente Mexico City Miyana (urban flagship)
Accor Group — Fairmont, Sofitel, Orient Express, MGallery, Emblems (urban + resort)
Independent / Experiential — Rosewood, Aman, Auberge, Raffles, Montage (high‑end, branded residences)
Wyndham/Hard Rock — Hard Rock Hotel Guadalajara, BelAir Unique (lifestyle urban)
Others — Grand Velas, JW Marriott (luxury resorts)

---

**Final Recommendation**  
Owners and developers targeting the upper‑upscale segment in Mexico should shortlist the following:

- For **all‑inclusive luxury resorts**: Hyatt Inclusive Collection (Secrets, Dreams, Zoëtry, Breathless)
- For **urban/lifestyle luxury hotels**: Andaz (Hyatt), St. Regis, Ritz‑Carlton, Rosewood, InterContinental
- For **high‑end experiential developments or branded residences**: Aman, Montage/Pendry, Raffles, Auberge
- For **curated lifestyle properties**: Hard Rock Hotel, BelAir Unique, and Accor’s MGallery or Emblems.

Each brand offers distinct strengths in terms of operational model, market positioning, design flexibility, and brand prestige. The final choice should align with your project's location, market segment, design aspirations, and ownership objectives.
